description: A React-like component definition using Lightning.js Blits framework for rendering a shopping cart view with dynamic item listing, subtotal calculation, and checkout button.

methods.name: onInc
methods.description: Increases the quantity of the current item in the cart.

methods.name: onDec
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of the current item in the cart, minimum of 1.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes the current item from the cart.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Initiates the checkout process if the cart is not empty.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates per-row variables based on current $item and $index for rendering.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes component state from store and computes layout sizes.
